modules.title: Design secure access to AWS resources

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: AWS secures the cloud infrastructure, while __________ their data, identities, configurations, and workloads in the cloud.

reveal.text: AWS secures the cloud infrastructure, while customers secure their data, identities, configurations, and workloads in the cloud.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use the root user only for tasks that require it, protect it with __________, and use least-privilege identities for daily work.

reveal.text: Use the root user only for tasks that require it, protect it with MFA, and use least-privilege identities for daily work.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not treat AWS-managed infrastructure security as a __________ for customer-side IAM, data protection, or operating-system controls.

reveal.text: Do not treat AWS-managed infrastructure security as a replacement for customer-side IAM, data protection, or operating-system controls.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: If a scenario asks who patches the guest OS on EC2, that responsibility belongs to the __________.

reveal.text: If a scenario asks who patches the guest OS on EC2, that responsibility belongs to the customer.

source_refs.title: Design secure access to AWS resources — official exam guide
Shared responsibility and root-user hygiene — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: IAM authorization evaluates applicable identity and resource policies, and an __________ overrides an Allow.

reveal.text: IAM authorization evaluates applicable identity and resource policies, and an explicit Deny overrides an Allow.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use least-privilege policies with narrow actions and resources, then add __________ when access should depend on context.

reveal.text: Use least-privilege policies with narrow actions and resources, then add conditions when access should depend on context.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not assume that attaching another Allow policy can __________ an explicit Deny.

reveal.text: Do not assume that attaching another Allow policy can override an explicit Deny.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: When an allowed action still fails, look for an __________ in an SCP, permissions boundary, identity policy, or resource policy.

reveal.text: When an allowed action still fails, look for an explicit Deny in an SCP, permissions boundary, identity policy, or resource policy.

source_refs.title: Design secure access to AWS resources — official exam guide
IAM policies and explicit deny — AWS documentation

nodes.title: IAM roles, STS, and cross-account access

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: IAM roles provide __________ and are commonly assumed through AWS STS instead of using long-term access keys.

reveal.text: IAM roles provide temporary credentials and are commonly assumed through AWS STS instead of using long-term access keys.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use a role with a __________ for cross-account access, workload identities, and temporary privileged sessions.

reveal.text: Use a role with a trust policy for cross-account access, workload identities, and temporary privileged sessions.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not embed IAM user __________ in applications when a service or workload can assume a role.

reveal.text: Do not embed IAM user access keys in applications when a service or workload can assume a role.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Cross-account access with temporary credentials points to an IAM role plus AWS STS __________.

reveal.text: Cross-account access with temporary credentials points to an IAM role plus AWS STS AssumeRole.

source_refs.title: Design secure access to AWS resources — official exam guide
IAM roles, STS, and cross-account access — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: AWS IAM Identity Center centralizes workforce access to multiple AWS accounts and applications by using federated identities and __________.

reveal.text: AWS IAM Identity Center centralizes workforce access to multiple AWS accounts and applications by using federated identities and permission sets.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use it when employees need centrally managed __________ across an AWS organization instead of separate IAM users in every account.

reveal.text: Use it when employees need centrally managed single sign-on across an AWS organization instead of separate IAM users in every account.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not create __________ long-lived IAM users in each account when centralized workforce federation satisfies the requirement.

reveal.text: Do not create duplicate long-lived IAM users in each account when centralized workforce federation satisfies the requirement.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: A multi-account workforce SSO requirement is a strong clue for __________.

reveal.text: A multi-account workforce SSO requirement is a strong clue for IAM Identity Center.

source_refs.title: Design secure access to AWS resources — official exam guide
IAM Identity Center and federation — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: AWS Organizations groups accounts, SCPs set permission __________, and AWS Control Tower helps establish and govern a multi-account landing zone.

reveal.text: AWS Organizations groups accounts, SCPs set permission guardrails, and AWS Control Tower helps establish and govern a multi-account landing zone.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use SCPs to define the __________ available to member accounts while identity policies grant actual permissions within those boundaries.

reveal.text: Use SCPs to define the maximum permissions available to member accounts while identity policies grant actual permissions within those boundaries.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: An SCP __________ permissions by itself; it limits what identity and resource policies can allow.

reveal.text: An SCP does not grant permissions by itself; it limits what identity and resource policies can allow.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: If many accounts must be prevented from using a service or Region, consider an Organizations __________.

reveal.text: If many accounts must be prevented from using a service or Region, consider an Organizations SCP.

source_refs.title: Design secure access to AWS resources — official exam guide
Organizations, SCPs, and Control Tower — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Resource-based policies attach to supported AWS resources and can name __________ that are allowed or denied access.

reveal.text: Resource-based policies attach to supported AWS resources and can name principals that are allowed or denied access.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use them for cases such as __________ S3 bucket access, KMS key access, SNS topics, or SQS queues.

reveal.text: Use them for cases such as cross-account S3 bucket access, KMS key access, SNS topics, or SQS queues.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not confuse a resource policy, which names who may access a resource, with a security group, which filters __________.

reveal.text: Do not confuse a resource policy, which names who may access a resource, with a security group, which filters network traffic.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: A question that asks which principal from another account can access an S3 bucket usually points to a __________.

reveal.text: A question that asks which principal from another account can access an S3 bucket usually points to a bucket policy.

source_refs.title: Design secure access to AWS resources — official exam guide
Resource-based policies — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: A permissions boundary sets the __________ that an IAM user or role can receive from identity-based policies.

reveal.text: A permissions boundary sets the maximum permissions that an IAM user or role can receive from identity-based policies.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use a boundary when delegated administrators may create roles but must not exceed a defined __________.

reveal.text: Use a boundary when delegated administrators may create roles but must not exceed a defined permission ceiling.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: A permissions boundary __________ permissions and does not replace an Organizations SCP for account-wide guardrails.

reveal.text: A permissions boundary does not grant permissions and does not replace an Organizations SCP for account-wide guardrails.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Delegated role creation with a maximum-permission ceiling is a __________ scenario.

reveal.text: Delegated role creation with a maximum-permission ceiling is a permissions-boundary scenario.

source_refs.title: Design secure access to AWS resources — official exam guide
Permissions boundaries — AWS documentation

nodes.title: VPC segmentation: public and private tiers

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: A subnet is public when its route table provides a path to an __________; private application and database tiers normally avoid direct inbound internet paths.

reveal.text: A subnet is public when its route table provides a path to an internet gateway; private application and database tiers normally avoid direct inbound internet paths.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Place internet-facing load balancers in public subnets and application or database resources in __________ when they do not need direct internet exposure.

reveal.text: Place internet-facing load balancers in public subnets and application or database resources in private subnets when they do not need direct internet exposure.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: A public IP address alone does not make a subnet public without an appropriate __________ to an internet gateway.

reveal.text: A public IP address alone does not make a subnet public without an appropriate route to an internet gateway.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: A multi-tier web application usually exposes the __________, not the database subnet, to the internet.

reveal.text: A multi-tier web application usually exposes the load balancer, not the database subnet, to the internet.

source_refs.title: Design secure workloads and applications — official exam guide
VPC segmentation: public and private tiers — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Security groups are __________ controls attached to resources such as ENIs, while network ACLs are stateless controls applied at the subnet boundary.

reveal.text: Security groups are stateful controls attached to resources such as ENIs, while network ACLs are stateless controls applied at the subnet boundary.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use security groups for resource-level allow rules and network ACLs when subnet-level allow and __________ are required.

reveal.text: Use security groups for resource-level allow rules and network ACLs when subnet-level allow and deny rules are required.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not expect a security group to support __________ rules; security groups use allow rules and track return traffic statefully.

reveal.text: Do not expect a security group to support explicit Deny rules; security groups use allow rules and track return traffic statefully.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: A requirement for an explicit subnet-level deny points to a __________.

reveal.text: A requirement for an explicit subnet-level deny points to a network ACL.

source_refs.title: Design secure workloads and applications — official exam guide
Security groups vs network ACLs — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: VPC endpoints provide __________ to supported services without requiring traffic to traverse an internet gateway or NAT gateway.

reveal.text: VPC endpoints provide private access to supported services without requiring traffic to traverse an internet gateway or NAT gateway.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use __________ for supported services such as S3 and DynamoDB, and interface endpoints powered by AWS PrivateLink for many other services.

reveal.text: Use gateway endpoints for supported services such as S3 and DynamoDB, and interface endpoints powered by AWS PrivateLink for many other services.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not add a __________ solely to reach a supported AWS service privately when an appropriate VPC endpoint meets the requirement.

reveal.text: Do not add a NAT gateway solely to reach a supported AWS service privately when an appropriate VPC endpoint meets the requirement.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Private access to an AWS API from private subnets without public internet is a __________ clue.

reveal.text: Private access to an AWS API from private subnets without public internet is a VPC endpoint clue.

source_refs.title: Design secure workloads and applications — official exam guide
VPC endpoints and AWS PrivateLink — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: AWS Secrets Manager stores sensitive credentials and supports controlled retrieval and __________ for supported secret types.

reveal.text: AWS Secrets Manager stores sensitive credentials and supports controlled retrieval and automated rotation for supported secret types.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use it for database passwords, API credentials, and other secrets that applications should __________ instead of embedding in code.

reveal.text: Use it for database passwords, API credentials, and other secrets that applications should retrieve at runtime instead of embedding in code.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not __________ reusable credentials in source code, AMIs, Lambda environment variables in plaintext, or container images.

reveal.text: Do not hardcode reusable credentials in source code, AMIs, Lambda environment variables in plaintext, or container images.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: A requirement to rotate a database password automatically points to __________.

reveal.text: A requirement to rotate a database password automatically points to Secrets Manager.

source_refs.title: Design secure workloads and applications — official exam guide
Secrets Manager — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: AWS WAF filters HTTP and HTTPS requests with __________ rules, while AWS Shield provides managed protection against distributed denial-of-service attacks.

reveal.text: AWS WAF filters HTTP and HTTPS requests with web ACL rules, while AWS Shield provides managed protection against distributed denial-of-service attacks.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use WAF for application-layer patterns such as __________ or rate-based rules, and Shield for DDoS protection.

reveal.text: Use WAF for application-layer patterns such as SQL injection or rate-based rules, and Shield for DDoS protection.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not use a __________ as a substitute for HTTP-aware WAF rules that inspect web requests.

reveal.text: Do not use a security group as a substitute for HTTP-aware WAF rules that inspect web requests.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: SQL injection filtering points to __________; DDoS protection points to Shield.

reveal.text: SQL injection filtering points to WAF; DDoS protection points to Shield.

source_refs.title: Design secure workloads and applications — official exam guide
AWS WAF and AWS Shield — AWS documentation

nodes.title: GuardDuty, Inspector, Macie, and Security Hub

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: GuardDuty detects suspicious activity, Inspector identifies software and network exposure vulnerabilities, Macie discovers sensitive data in S3, and Security Hub __________.

reveal.text: GuardDuty detects suspicious activity, Inspector identifies software and network exposure vulnerabilities, Macie discovers sensitive data in S3, and Security Hub aggregates security findings.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Choose among these services based on whether the __________ is threat detection, vulnerability management, sensitive-data discovery, or centralized findings.

reveal.text: Choose among these services based on whether the requirement is threat detection, vulnerability management, sensitive-data discovery, or centralized findings.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not choose __________ to scan EC2 packages for CVEs or Inspector to classify sensitive S3 data.

reveal.text: Do not choose Macie to scan EC2 packages for CVEs or Inspector to classify sensitive S3 data.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Sensitive-data discovery in S3 points to Macie; package vulnerability findings point to __________.

reveal.text: Sensitive-data discovery in S3 points to Macie; package vulnerability findings point to Inspector.

source_refs.title: Design secure workloads and applications — official exam guide
GuardDuty, Inspector, Macie, and Security Hub — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: AWS KMS creates and controls __________ that AWS services can use to protect data at rest.

reveal.text: AWS KMS creates and controls encryption keys that AWS services can use to protect data at rest.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use __________ KMS keys when you need direct control over key policy, lifecycle, rotation choices, or cross-account permissions.

reveal.text: Use customer managed KMS keys when you need direct control over key policy, lifecycle, rotation choices, or cross-account permissions.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not assume an IAM Allow is sufficient when a KMS __________ does not permit the required use.

reveal.text: Do not assume an IAM Allow is sufficient when a KMS key policy does not permit the required use.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Fine-grained control over who can use an encryption key points to a customer managed __________ and its key policy.

reveal.text: Fine-grained control over who can use an encryption key points to a customer managed KMS key and its key policy.

source_refs.title: Determine appropriate data security controls — official exam guide
KMS encryption and key policies — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: AWS Certificate Manager provisions and manages __________ for supported integrated AWS services.

reveal.text: AWS Certificate Manager provisions and manages TLS certificates for supported integrated AWS services.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use ACM certificates with services such as Elastic Load Balancing and CloudFront to __________ client connections in transit.

reveal.text: Use ACM certificates with services such as Elastic Load Balancing and CloudFront to encrypt client connections in transit.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not use __________ data-encryption keys as TLS certificates for HTTPS listeners.

reveal.text: Do not use KMS data-encryption keys as TLS certificates for HTTPS listeners.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: A managed public certificate for an HTTPS load balancer listener points to __________.

reveal.text: A managed public certificate for an HTTPS load balancer listener points to ACM.

source_refs.title: Determine appropriate data security controls — official exam guide
ACM and encryption in transit — AWS documentation

nodes.title: S3 access, versioning, lifecycle, and Object Lock

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Amazon S3 combines IAM and bucket policies with features such as versioning, lifecycle rules, replication, and __________ to control access and protect object data.

reveal.text: Amazon S3 combines IAM and bucket policies with features such as versioning, lifecycle rules, replication, and Object Lock to control access and protect object data.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use __________ for recoverability from overwrites or deletes and Object Lock when write-once-read-many retention is required.

reveal.text: Use versioning for recoverability from overwrites or deletes and Object Lock when write-once-read-many retention is required.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not treat lifecycle expiration as a __________; lifecycle rules can permanently remove data.

reveal.text: Do not treat lifecycle expiration as a backup strategy; lifecycle rules can permanently remove data.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: A compliance requirement that objects cannot be deleted before a retention date points to S3 __________.

reveal.text: A compliance requirement that objects cannot be deleted before a retention date points to S3 Object Lock.

source_refs.title: Determine appropriate data security controls — official exam guide
S3 access, versioning, lifecycle, and Object Lock — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Backups create __________, while replication maintains additional copies in another location for availability, locality, or disaster-recovery objectives.

reveal.text: Backups create recoverable copies, while replication maintains additional copies in another location for availability, locality, or disaster-recovery objectives.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use __________ for centralized policy-based backups and service-native replication when low RPO or regional copy requirements demand it.

reveal.text: Use AWS Backup for centralized policy-based backups and service-native replication when low RPO or regional copy requirements demand it.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not assume that a read replica or __________ object replaces every backup requirement, because logical deletion or corruption can also replicate.

reveal.text: Do not assume that a read replica or replicated object replaces every backup requirement, because logical deletion or corruption can also replicate.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: A centralized backup policy across multiple AWS services and accounts points to __________.

reveal.text: A centralized backup policy across multiple AWS services and accounts points to AWS Backup.

source_refs.title: Determine appropriate data security controls — official exam guide
Backup and replication controls — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Data classification identifies __________ or regulated information so that access, encryption, retention, and monitoring controls can match the data's requirements.

reveal.text: Data classification identifies sensitive or regulated information so that access, encryption, retention, and monitoring controls can match the data's requirements.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use Amazon __________ when the architecture needs automated discovery of sensitive data in S3 as part of a governance program.

reveal.text: Use Amazon Macie when the architecture needs automated discovery of sensitive data in S3 as part of a governance program.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not apply __________ retention and access controls to all data when classifications have different legal or business requirements.

reveal.text: Do not apply identical retention and access controls to all data when classifications have different legal or business requirements.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Discover personally identifiable information stored in S3 is a __________ clue.

reveal.text: Discover personally identifiable information stored in S3 is a Macie clue.

source_refs.title: Determine appropriate data security controls — official exam guide
Data classification and governance — AWS documentation
